audit.why: 53.35% over 5273 games with [Skill, Lucian, Lucian, Sion, Sion, Sion, Sion] — packet and win[] agree row for row and the prose matches. The mirrored lucian__sion audit also reports it left the chart rows alone because they were right. No chart edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never mentions The Culling. Level 6 is written as if only Sion gains an ultimate.
audit.why: Lucian's R is a 1400-range torrent of shots on 110s at rank 1 — the single largest damage window in the matchup and the reason a Sion who walks a straight line at 6 can die before the knockup lands. Its absence makes the level-6 section read as a free win.
audit.corrected: The Culling stated with its range and 110s cooldown in mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields say Relentless Pursuit RESETS on every Lightslinger proc, and whys[0] says it 'has no cooldown cost at level 1'.
audit.why: Riot's text is 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown' — reduce, not reset — and the cooldown is 16s at rank 1, barely moving to 14s at rank 5. What actually falls to zero is its MANA cost (32/24/16/8/0), which is probably where 'no cost' came from. The difference decides the lane: as written, the player believes the dash is always available and never charges Q; in fact he gets roughly one dash per trade at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Cooldown stated as 16s at rank 1 with the reduction (not reset) mechanic, and the mana-cost decay named separately. Ardent Blaze added as the other half of his kiting — it marks you and gives him move speed for attacking marked targets.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lightslinger's immobilize clause is never mentioned.
audit.why: 'When a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.' Sion's whole kit is immobilizing things, so his own stuns can arm the enemy laner's passive — a genuine hidden interaction that changes when you want the knockup to land.

edits.before: Lucian's E has no cooldown cost at level 1 and he dashes away from every Q wind-up — W-shield his double-shot and farm with Q-tip; landing a stun is nearly impossible.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1, so he gets one dash per trade — W-shield his double-shot, farm with the Q tip, and charge once that dash is spent, not before.

edits.before: He resets Relentless Pursuit on every Lightslinger proc and owns short trades with his Q Piercing Light — your W-shield delays him but you cannot match his damage output at level 2.
edits.after: Lightslinger attacks only shave time off Relentless Pursuit, but he still owns short trades with Piercing Light — W-shield delays him and you cannot match his output at level 2.

edits.before: Unstoppable Onslaught closes the gap Lucian relies on — R in on his E cooldown, land the charged-Q knockup, and your E armor-shred makes the brawl entirely one-sided.
edits.after: Unstoppable Onslaught closes the gap Lucian relies on — R in while his 16s dash is down, land the charged-Q knockup, and E armor-shred makes the brawl entirely one-sided.

edits.before: Lucian's Relentless Pursuit (E) resets on each Lightslinger proc — he dashes away from every charged-Q attempt and wins the poke war cleanly while your Q is winding.
edits.after: Lightslinger attacks shorten Relentless Pursuit but never reset it — at 16s he gets one dash, and Ardent Blaze's move speed does the rest of the kiting while your Q winds up.

edits.before: Lucian's E resets on every Lightslinger passive proc, meaning he can sprint out of your Q wind-up animation every single time at levels 1-3. Don't stand still charging your Q into the open — he reads the telegraph and dashes backward before the slam lands, then punishes your commitment with a double-shot and Q Piercing Light to the face. Your W-shield is your main tool here: pop it when he steps up to double-shot, tank the poke, and deny him clean damage. Last-hit from maximum range and accept that you are not winning short trades until your kit and HP count come online.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit is a 16-second cooldown at rank 1 — its MANA cost falls to nothing with rank, but the dash never becomes spammable, and Lightslinger attacks only shave time off it. Charge Q once it is spent and he has to walk. Until then do not stand still in the open: he reads the telegraph, dashes back, and punishes with a double-shot and Piercing Light. Ardent Blaze is the other half of his kiting — a mark on you gives him move speed for attacking you. Pop W when he steps up, tank the poke, and last-hit at max range.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a lull, but Level 6 changes everything. Your Unstoppable Onslaught (R) is not a gimmick — it is the one tool in your kit that closes distance faster than Lucian's E can reposition. Use R to commit at a moment when his E is on cooldown or recently used, then immediately follow with a charged-Q ground-slam as the knockup locks him in place. Your E armor-shred lands for free while he is stunned, and now the trade is a brawl you win. He has no reliable answer to a stunned state; his double-shot passive requires him to walk between shots, and a stunned Lucian cannot walk anywhere.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a lull, but Level 6 changes everything. Your Unstoppable Onslaught (R) is the one tool in your kit that closes distance faster than Lucian's E can reposition. Commit with it while his 16s dash is down, then follow with a charged-Q ground-slam as the knockup locks him in place, and your E armor-shred lands for free. Two cautions: The Culling is a 1400-range torrent on a 110s cooldown, and Lightslinger gives him bonus magic damage on his next two attacks whenever a nearby enemy is immobilized — so a stun landing on a teammate arms him against you.

notes: The load-bearing error was 'his E resets on every Lightslinger proc', repeated in three fields. Riot's text says Lightslinger attacks REDUCE the cooldown, and that cooldown is 16s at rank 1 — the player was being told the dash is permanently available, which is why the page concludes a stun is 'nearly impossible' early. What actually drops to zero is the mana cost. Lucian's ultimate was missing from the page entirely; it is now in mid with its range and cooldown. I did NOT write anti-heal despite the brief's needs-antiheal flag on Lightslinger: Riot's passive text contains no healing at all (double-shot, plus bonus magic damage when he is healed or shielded BY AN ALLY or an enemy is immobilized), so the derived heal flag looks like tooltip-parse misfire on the word 'healed'. Per the flag-vs-description rule I trusted the description. Worth a sweep — the same flag may be arming anti-heal advice on other Lucian pages. currentText.full is null here, so all edits are content layer.
